fields.summary_ko.0: President Trump disclosed purchases of Tesla (TSLA) on 4 occasions ($117,004-$330,000) September 1-10 and SpaceX (SPCX) on 2 occasions plus bond purchases ($116,002-$315,000) September 23.
fields.summary_ko.1: During same period, Trump sold large-cap stocks including McDonald's, Home Depot, Comcast, Nike totaling approximately $10-30 million and purchased Vanguard Dividend Appreciation ETF (VIG) for $5-25 million.
fields.summary_ko.2: Of large-cap stocks Trump sold after trading, 4 appreciated more than 10%, while FIS avoided 25% decline, showing mixed results typical of most individual investors.
